description: This file implements a plugin for a development tool ('devtool') that manages deployment and undeployment of build artifacts to remote targets, primarily over SSH. It includes functions for preparing deployment scripts, executing deployment and undeployment operations, and registering command-line subcommands. The code handles building command scripts, transferring files via SCP, and executing remote commands for deploying or removing files, especially in embedded or constrained environments.

methods.name: _prepare_remote_script(deploy, verbose=False, dryrun=False, undeployall=False, nopreserve=False, nocheckspace=False)
methods.description: Generates a shell script string for remote deployment or undeployment operations, considering dry runs, preservation, space checks, and undeploy all options.

methods.name: deploy(args, config, basepath, workspace)
methods.description: Main function to handle deploying build recipe output files to a remote target over SSH, including preparing scripts, copying files, and executing remote commands.

methods.name: undeploy(args, config, basepath, workspace)
methods.description: Main function to handle undeploying (removing) files from a remote target, either specific recipes or all deployed items.

methods.name: register_commands(subparsers, context)
methods.description: Registers 'deploy-target' and 'undeploy-target' subcommands with a command-line parser, defining arguments and linking to deployment functions.
